return_policy.title: Return Policy
conditions: Items must be unused and in original packaging.
Return request must be submitted within 30 days of delivery.
Electronics must include all original accessories.
Sale items and gift cards are final sale and cannot be returned.
return_policy.process: Contact customer support to receive a return shipping label. Ship the item back within 7 days of receiving the label.

refund_policy.title: Refund Policy
conditions: Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the returned item is inspected.
Shipping costs are non-refundable unless the return is due to a defective or incorrect item.
Partial refunds may be issued for items that show signs of use.
refund_policy.process: Once the returned item passes inspection, the refund is processed within 5-10 business days.

cancellation_policy.title: Cancellation Policy
conditions: Orders can be cancelled before they enter the 'shipped' status.
Orders that have already shipped cannot be cancelled and must follow the return process.
Refunds for cancelled orders are processed within 3-5 business days.

shipping_policy.title: Shipping Policy
conditions: Free standard shipping on orders over $50.
Express shipping is available for an additional fee.
International shipping is not currently available.
Delivery times are estimates and may vary.
